intro: Legal support for company formation, corporate restructuring and acquisitions, for Hungarian and international businesses.
services: Legal due diligence, transaction documents and negotiations

content.text: We have experience advising on large M&A transactions throughout the entire transaction process, both on the legal, due diligence and drafting aspects as well as on project management aspects of a major transaction. We also provide corporate legal services for almost all of our clients, from company incorporations and modifications to more complex restructurings (mergers, de-mergers).
